health.description:
A "discretized" health value, representing the health of a model at a point in time. The possible values or
enumerations will depend on the application. This is the single "at-a-glance" value that is associated with
a model's health in an application.
For extra details on health, see {@link #notes}.

e.g. "RED", "YELLOW", "GREEN"
e.g. "P0", "P1", "P2", "P3", "P4"

error.description: This field is populated if there was any error raised during the calculation of the health value.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

calcResult.description: Optional reference to the specific batch in {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job} that produced this value.

jobRun.description: Optional reference to the {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.JobRun} that produced this value.

title:
An instance of {@link MlModel.Health.History} holds the health for a specific {@link MlModel} at a specific point in time.
In aggregate, this persistable type can be used to track the health history of a model.

Instances of this type are intended to be created by {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job}.
name: MlModel.Health.History
